name: KinetiQ E1
description: Benchmark harness, extracted measurement core, per-repetition outputs and figure scripts supporting the manuscript "Benchmarking the Deployed Artifact: Verbatim-Extraction Testing and Viewing-Angle Error Decomposition of a Browser-Based Markerless Movement Assessment Platform" (submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics). The harness slices the measurement functions of a deployed single-page web application from its shipped source by line range, records a SHA-256 for each, and executes them unmodified against three reference tiers (analytic synthetic kinematics; motion-capture trajectories injected at the landmark interface, REHAB24-6 and UI-PRMD; and end-to-end video through the production MediaPipe configuration). Raw datasets are not redistributed here: REHAB24-6 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.13305826, CC BY-NC 4.0) and UI-PRMD (University of Idaho, ODC-PDDL v1.0) must be obtained from their original sources. Source repository: https://github.com/y3korea/kinetiq-e1-benchmark Changes in v1.0.1: three REHAB24-6 files (Segmentation.csv, marker_names.txt, joints_names.txt) that v1.0.0 had included verbatim were removed, because that material is CC BY-NC 4.0 and could not be released under this archive's MIT terms. They are replaced by E1_benchmark/data/gt/FETCH.md giving the original sources and SHA-256 checksums.
